notes: ASSUMPTIONS for self-hosting. Chain: quality need → model size class → VRAM needed → cheapest GPU class with enough VRAM (prices.json) → throughput (prices.json gpu_throughput). Open-weight models may trail frontier API models; test on your own task.

small.label: Small open model (~8B parameters, 16-bit)
small.why: ~16 GB weights + KV cache for batched requests
small.kv_why: Llama 3.1 8B layout: 32 layers × 8 KV heads × 128 dims × 2 (K and V) × 2 bytes = 128 KB per token

medium.label: Medium open model (~32B parameters, 4-bit quantised)
medium.why: ~18 GB weights + KV cache and activation headroom
medium.kv_why: Qwen 2.5 32B layout: 64 layers × 8 KV heads × 128 dims × 2 × 2 bytes = 256 KB per token

large.label: Large open model (~70B parameters, 4-bit quantised)
large.why: ~40 GB weights + KV cache for batched requests
large.kv_why: Llama 3.3 70B layout: 80 layers × 8 KV heads × 128 dims × 2 × 2 bytes = 320 KB per token

capacity_note: ASSUMPTIONS. KV cache room per GPU = VRAM × usable share − weights. Requests in flight (Little's law) use stream_tokens_per_sec, the speed one answer is written at under batching. KV cache stored at 16 bits.
open_model_note: Open-weight models may trail frontier models on some tasks; evaluate on your own data before committing.
